status: Original native file owner admission verified for complete workers and per-file companion calls; compound command authority remains incomplete
implementation: Bounded owner rows use the original crash-safe SQLite publisher. Private issuer credentials are stored only as digests bound to immutable account/project/journal/generation claims.

The common native owner publisher persists intent before the backend worker CAS for complete workers and per-file companion calls. Both native transports reuse Journal private response validation. A lost/rejected claim retains intent.

The common Coordinator rejects ordinary overlapping writers, including physical aliases, ancestors/descendants, moved original roots and lexical replacement paths. Fresh private original permits are required to recover.

File-only ownership is removed only under the original physical lease, after observing original compound inactivity and acknowledging worker release. A stored command owner cannot be cleared by file completion.
Private Local proof/read access can reconnect a pending owner but cannot construct a mutation VFS or acquire process descriptors.

Original root and same-filesystem ancestor identities persist across container recreation. Enclosing runtime mount identities are retained for overlap observations but do not change original-owner equality.

Per-file native sessions retain their original private permit so accepted writes enter the physical queue before network waits. Current backend worker authority is rechecked under the gate before mutation.

Closing a session whose account cancellation revoked private reads can release/retire the session but cannot clear its durable owner. A fresh original bootstrap can positively observe cancellation and clear file-only protection.

limits.schema: Existing schema2 namespace migrates to schema3 on first owner enrollment; no empty reset or age takeover

linux_container_owner_cases.fixture_private_issuer: Native policy fixture; actual private issuance/transport verified separately

macOS_and_linux_cases: Rejected backend CAS retains original native owner before any filesystem effects.

Lost/timed-out observers cannot let a newer proof overtake accepted writes.
Prepared account cancellation revokes calls but closing alone retains durable protection; original regrant clears it.
companion_contract.test_isolation: Each independent test machine has a separate registry. All participating hosts, accounts and projects within a test share its original registry.
